summary: Blackstone Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K reporting its 2026 annual meeting results and, under Item 8.01, disclosure of an unsolicited mini-tender by Cox Capital Retail Secondaries Fund I, LP for up to $20 million of Class I shares at $20.65 per share. That price equals a 12.5% discount to BCRED's published August 31, 2026 Class I NAV of $23.60. The Board unanimously recommended shareholders reject and not tender, calling the offer de minimis and substantially undervaluing shares. Cox Capital is unaffiliated; the offer is not a negotiated transaction. Watch for shareholder tendering errors and potential extension or amendment of the mini-tender.
